pack.problem: AEGIS research trigger: scheduled_cadence. Current PF=None, EV=None
pack.proposed_change: Test a spread-timing recovery rule instead of pure abstention: for candidates rejected by the current soft spread-volatility gate (signals arising when rolling spread volatility exceeds its ~80th percentile), re-enter the signal one bar later and accept only if realized spread at the delayed fill has reverted below the rolling median. Falsifiable prediction: on the sealed holdout set, this recovers at least 30% of soft-gate-rejected candidates while holding mean execution cost within the runner'
pack.risks: unvalidated idea; tiny DEMO risk only

concerns: Truncated acceptance criteria: the spread-reversion predicate and the runner cost bound are incomplete, making the falsifiable prediction untestable as specified

Lookahead risk: 'realized spread at the delayed fill' must be conditioned on spread observable at order-submission time (current quote vs rolling median), not on post-trade realized costs, or the test peeks at the label

Threshold/delay parameters (~80th percentile, 1-bar lag) appear chosen post hoc from the same regime that generated the rejections; multiple-testing risk unless validated strictly on the sealed holdout with the experiment registered beforehand
No minimum sample-size floor stated for the >=30% recovery-rate claim; high-percentile rejection buckets may be too sparse on the holdout to support it
Delayed entry changes the trade's price context by one bar; without specifying entry/stop/target recomputation, recovered-candidate performance conflates spread-timing effect with price-drift effect
votes.reason: The core idea is sound and safety-compatible: converting soft-gate abstentions into a one-bar-delayed conditional re-entry is a legitimate research question, it targets exploration/OOS validation only, keeps champion promotion untouched, and carries no live exposure. However, the proposal as submitted is materially incomplete: both 'current_evidence' and 'proposed_change' truncate mid-sentence ('...delayed fill ha', '...within the runner''), so the exact re-entry predicate and the cost bound in the falsifiable prediction cannot be evaluated as written. Additional unspecified details (lookahead-safe conditioning, minimum holdout sample size, whether stops/targets are recomputed at t+1) determine whether the >=30% recovery claim would even be meaningful.
requested_revisions: Resubmit with the complete re-entry rule and the full cost bound ('within the runner's ...' finished explicitly)
State that the delayed-fill acceptance check uses only quote-side information available at submission time; document this as the anti-lookahead guarantee
Pre-register a minimum holdout sample size (and the exact metric definitions) for the >=30% recovery claim via ExperimentRegistry before any run

Specify whether entry, stop, and target are recomputed at t+1, and report recovered-candidate net expectancy against both the pure-abstention baseline and the original ungated entries under identical runner spread/slippage assumptions

Confirm scope: all artifacts stay research-only (bot/research/, bot/reports/research/); no writes to bot/intel/intelligent_champion.json outside the governed promote path; no MT5 mutation from research components

Affected runtime paths could accidentally alter execution behavior before governed promotion.
